numbering: Episodes numbered continuously across both seasons: Season 1 is 1-12 and Season 2 is 13-23 (Wikipedia overall numbering); the 2020 bonus OVAs are unnumbered.

arcs.name: Caiman in the Hole
arcs.summary: In the grimy city of the Hole, an amnesiac man cursed with a lizard head hunts sorcerers to find out who did this to him. Meanwhile the powerful sorcerer En sends his cleaners to deal with the sorcerer-killer.
events: Caiman bites sorcerers' heads so the man inside his mouth can judge whether they are the culprit.
Caiman is decapitated during a zombie festival but survives.
Caiman and Nikaido meet Dr. Kasukabe, who shows them a magic door.
Caiman recalls that the man in his mouth is named Risu.

arcs.name: Blue Night
arcs.summary: Caiman crosses into the sorcerers' world as the Blue Night festival approaches, while En's family closes in on Nikaido.
events: Noi, under a curse, transforms into a reptilian creature.
En forces Nikaido into a contract after learning her secret.
Caiman storms En's mansion to rescue Nikaido.
Nikaido is stabbed, and she and Caiman vow to stay friends whatever comes.

arcs.name: The Cross-Eyes
arcs.summary: Six years after the first season, the story returns to the Hole with the Cross-Eyes gang taking center stage and the mystery of Caiman's identity unravelling.
events: The season opens on the Cross-Eyes and on Risu's search for the man who killed him.
En serves a dream-inducing mushroom that exposes everyone's desires, and Ebisu sets out to find her parents.
Caiman and Nikaido's friendship is pushed to a breaking point.
A third season was announced after the finale.

filler.note: No filler: every numbered episode adapts the manga (the six 2020 OVAs are separate bonus shorts).
